name: What is involved in a whole-home renovation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a whole-home renovation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home renovation with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive transformation of your residence, addressing inconsistent finishes, inefficient room flow, and dated kitchens or bathrooms. We create a coordinated renovation plan that sequences demolition, structural changes, kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring, lighting, paint, carpentry, and final finish work. Our integrated design-build process ensures a cohesive outcome where all rooms feel connected in style and function, managed by a single, accountable team from concept to completion. This approach helps homeowners avoid the complexities and potential inefficiencies of managing multiple vendors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-home renovation with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive, coordinated transformation of your residence, managed by a single design-build team from concept to completion.
